item.description:
Location: Dubai, UAE
Description:

A shipowning company is seeking an experienced Vessel Planner for its fleet of bulk carriers and tankers based in Dubai, UAE. The role involves optimizing fleet scheduling, cargo stowage, and voyage execution, acting as a central link between chartering, vessel Masters, and port agents. Responsibilities include developing schedules, coordinating cargo plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and tracking vessel ETAs. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and at least 5 years of experience in vessel planning or fleet scheduling are required.
